---
title: "Sensitivity and Specificity Analysis"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(flextable)
library(officer)
library(binom)
library(stats)
library(rprojroot)

## Data Import and Preprocessing

# Load the data
data <- read.delim(sprintf("%s/data/sars-cov2_date_site_genome_copies_RPKMF.tsv", find_rstudio_root_file()))

# Define positivity based on criteria, ensure all levels are present
data <- data %>% 
  mutate(
    qPCR_result = factor(ifelse(genome_copies > 0, "Positive", "Negative"), levels = c("Positive", "Negative")),
    RPKMF_result = factor(ifelse(RPKMF > 0, "Positive", "Negative"), levels = c("Positive", "Negative")),
    Coverage_result = factor(ifelse(coverage > 0, "Positive", "Negative"), levels = c("Positive", "Negative"))
  )


## Function for Sensitivity and Specificity Calculation

calculate_stats <- function(tp, fn, tn, fp) {
  # Handle division by zero cases
  sensitivity <- ifelse((tp + fn) > 0, tp / (tp + fn), 0)
  specificity <- ifelse((tn + fp) > 0, tn / (tn + fp), 0)

  # 95% CI using binomial exact method, handle zero cases
  if ((tp + fn) > 0) {
    sens_ci <- binom.confint(tp, tp + fn, method = "exact")
  } else {
    sens_ci <- list(lower = 0, upper = 0)
  }
  
  if ((tn + fp) > 0) {
    spec_ci <- binom.confint(tn, tn + fp, method = "exact")
  } else {
    spec_ci <- list(lower = 0, upper = 0)
  }

  # Fisher's Exact Test for P-value, handle edge cases
  contingency_matrix <- matrix(c(tp, fn, fp, tn), nrow = 2)
  # Check if any dimension is zero
  if (any(dim(contingency_matrix) == 0)) {
    p_value <- 1  # Default to non-significant if no data
  } else {
    p_value <- tryCatch({
      fisher.test(contingency_matrix)$p.value
    }, error = function(e) {
      1  # Default to non-significant if test fails
    })
  }
  p_value <- ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "P<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_value))

  return(list(
    sensitivity = round(sensitivity, 3),
    specificity = round(specificity, 3),
    sens_ci = paste0(round(sens_ci$lower, 3), "-", round(sens_ci$upper, 3)),
    spec_ci = paste0(round(spec_ci$lower, 3), "-", round(spec_ci$upper, 3)),
    p_value = p_value
  ))
}


## 2x2 Contingency Tables and Calculations

# RPKMF vs qPCR
RPKMF_table <- table(data$qPCR_result, data$RPKMF_result)

# Coverage vs qPCR
coverage_table <- table(data$qPCR_result, data$Coverage_result)

# Ensure contingency tables have all combinations using proper addmargins
# Create empty 2x2 tables with all possible combinations
full_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2, 
                    dimnames = list(c("Positive", "Negative"), 
                                    c("Positive", "Negative")))

# Add observed values to the full table
if(nrow(RPKMF_table) > 0 && ncol(RPKMF_table) > 0) {
  for(r in rownames(RPKMF_table)) {
    for(c in colnames(RPKMF_table)) {
      full_table[r, c] <- RPKMF_table[r, c]
    }
  }
}
RPKMF_table <- full_table

# Repeat for coverage table
full_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2, 
                    dimnames = list(c("Positive", "Negative"), 
                                    c("Positive", "Negative")))
if(nrow(coverage_table) > 0 && ncol(coverage_table) > 0) {
  for(r in rownames(coverage_table)) {
    for(c in colnames(coverage_table)) {
      full_table[r, c] <- coverage_table[r, c]
    }
  }
}
coverage_table <- full_table

# Sensitivity and Specificity
RPKMF_stats <- calculate_stats(
  RPKMF_table["Positive", "Positive"], 
  RPKMF_table["Positive", "Negative"], 
  RPKMF_table["Negative", "Negative"], 
  RPKMF_table["Negative", "Positive"]
)

coverage_stats <- calculate_stats(
  coverage_table["Positive", "Positive"], 
  coverage_table["Positive", "Negative"], 
  coverage_table["Negative", "Negative"], 
  coverage_table["Negative", "Positive"]
)

## Create Summary Tables

# RPKMF Table
RPKMF_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("True Positive", "False Negative", "True Negative", "False Positive", 
             "Sensitivity", "95% CI (Sensitivity)", "Specificity", "95% CI (Specificity)", "P-value"),
  Value = c(RPKMF_table["Positive", "Positive"], RPKMF_table["Positive", "Negative"], 
            RPKMF_table["Negative", "Negative"], RPKMF_table["Negative", "Positive"], 
            RPKMF_stats$sensitivity, RPKMF_stats$sens_ci, 
            RPKMF_stats$specificity, RPKMF_stats$spec_ci, RPKMF_stats$p_value)
)

# Coverage Table
coverage_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("True Positive", "False Negative", "True Negative", "False Positive", 
             "Sensitivity", "95% CI (Sensitivity)", "Specificity", "95% CI (Specificity)", "P-value"),
  Value = c(coverage_table["Positive", "Positive"], coverage_table["Positive", "Negative"], 
            coverage_table["Negative", "Negative"], coverage_table["Negative", "Positive"], 
            coverage_stats$sensitivity, coverage_stats$sens_ci, 
            coverage_stats$specificity, coverage_stats$spec_ci, coverage_stats$p_value)
)

## Export to Word Document

# Create a Word document
doc <- read_docx()

doc <- doc %>% 
  body_add_par("Sensitivity and Specificity Analysis", style = "heading 1") %>% 
  body_add_par("RPKMF vs qPCR Results", style = "heading 2") %>% 
  body_add_flextable(flextable(RPKMF_summary)) %>% 
  body_add_par("Coverage vs qPCR Results", style = "heading 2") %>% 
  body_add_flextable(flextable(coverage_summary))

# Save the document
print(doc, target = sprintf("%s/charts/RPKMF_Sensitivity_Specificity_Analysis.docx", find_rstudio_root_file()))

```
